_doc: First-week guide (user decision 8 Nov 2026). Each step shows once, the first time its 'when' matches. 'week' is the week of the game (1 = first week); 'month' is the month. The player can skip one step or all steps. {KEY} shows a BalanceConfig number.

lines: I saw the guild clerk at your door. That grey seal never brings good news.
I am Mbok Sari, from the jamu stall next door. Your parent and I shared this street for twenty years.
The debt is heavy. But it is not the end. We take it one week at a time.
This is your parent's planner book. Every week starts here. Put a goal card on each day.
On the Store plan page, choose what to sell. Then share your gold into three jars. The Buffer jar is for the debt, so try not to touch it.
When the plan feels right, press Finish plan at the top.
The week has started. This is your home and your shop.
Make products at the Crafting table. Put them on the shelf in the Store, then open the doors.
Every task takes time and energy. The green ring around the clock is your energy.
No herbs? Press Town and walk to the market or the guild.
Ah, the market. Prices change every week. Your planner book shows them.
At the stall, Fill from plan puts what your plan needs in the basket.
Buy some meal packs too. Working hungry makes a long day longer.
Tired already? A short break or a meal gives you energy back.
Sleep ends the day. Do not stay up for a few more coins. Tomorrow needs you too.
One week done. Let us look back, without blame.
Compare your plan with what really happened. Where did the gold go?
Then pick one or two notes for next week. Small changes add up.
Month end. The guild wants its payment today.
Pay at least {DEBT_MIN_PAYMENT} gold. If you can pay more, next month's interest is smaller.
Pay the utilities too. Unpaid bills go onto the debt.
Then you can book one guild appointment for next month.
You made it through a whole month. That counts for something.
